connector.name: Youfiliate Smart Links
connector.registryDescription: Create geo-targeted affiliate smart links, pull analytics, and rewrite YouTube descriptions.
connector.summary: Hosted at youfiliate-mcp.onrender.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package youfiliate-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the andrewmpierce account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your Youfiliate API key. Format: 'Bearer youfiliate_sk_your_key_here'.

env.name: YOUFILIATE_API_KEY
env.description: Your Youfiliate API key (starts with youfiliate_sk_). Generate one at https://youfiliate.com/settings.
